data.narrative: Alekhya demonstrated senior engineering leadership throughout Module 07, synthesizing the lessons of all 10 resolved system bugs into an exemplary blameless postmortem for the SEV1 admin auth bypass incident. She constructed a forensic, minute-level UTC timeline, articulated the technical root cause with surgical precision, and isolated 5 systemic, process-level contributing factors with zero individual blame. Furthermore, she defined 5 actionable, owner-backed remediation items with firm deadlines across Platform, Backend, and SRE teams, and demonstrated deep critical analysis by rewriting a flawed, blame-oriented migration postmortem into a resilient systems learning document.

dimension_scores.evidence: Focused on the 10-minute exploitation window, 47 DELETE requests, and 12 deleted links, resulting in 5 concrete owner-backed structural action items.

Forensic timeline precision: establishes unassailable UTC timestamped chronologies connecting alert detection, investigation, mitigation, and data restoration.
